note: Re-judged 2026-10-30 by an independent auditor (authored none of the userns spec commits d8427e4380, b00e3c6710, 68b723ec4f, 7d11a51269). userns.Enter (internal/test/userns/userns_linux.go) re-executes the one test in a new user+net+mount namespace and returns false in the parent only after the child's own PASS line; a child failure, a zero-exit failure or a child that selected nothing fails the parent, and a child skip skips it, so the guard cannot turn a red into a green. Section 3.4.3: "All AH implementations MUST support the anti-replay service, though its use may be enabled or disabled by the receiver on a per-SA basis." TestIPsecInstallerXFRMReplayWindow changed by the guard only (requireXFRM's CAP refusal now fails). It parses and validates the real config, runs the installer against kernel XFRM, and for replay-window 64, explicit 0 and the absent leaf requires each AH destination (ff02::5, ff02::6, fe80::1) exactly once with the exact window; extra, duplicate or non-AH states fail. Running in the child's own network namespace also means no foreign XFRM state can collide with the SPI. Proves Ze installs the per-SA anti-replay choice; Linux's per-packet sequence check is not claimed. Records (xfrmStateFromParams, buildIPsecSA reverts) current.
